# IA Connect

IA Connect is a web-based creative AI studio for generating images and videos with different artificial intelligence models in one interface.

Official site: https://ia-conect.paulo-direct-response.workers.dev/
Language: Portuguese (Brazil)

## Primary capabilities
- AI image generation and image editing workflows.
- AI video generation from prompts and image references.
- Multiple supported AI models in one studio.
- Credit-based usage with the price shown before generation.
- Reusable creative assets, references, history and library workflows.

## Public page
- https://ia-conect.paulo-direct-response.workers.dev/

This file is a supplemental machine-readable description of the public IA Connect product. Product behavior, availability and pricing shown by the application are authoritative.
